Target is a niche concrete pumping service provider, billed per job to construction contractors, operating pump fleets from branches in the U.S. and U.K. The comp is a vertically integrated, asphalt-centered civil infrastructure contractor. It paves, mills and maintains roads, runways and sites, and it owns hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities and liquid asphalt terminals. Both operate in construction, but the services differ (concrete placement versus road paving and asphalt production). The comp's work is mainly public road contracts and its revenue includes materials, so the business model differs too. Any customer overlap is incidental.

P1.2.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services and concrete waste management solutions in the U.S. and U.K., operating under the only established, national brands in both countries.

P1.3.text: Concrete Pumping Holdings is the leading provider of concrete pumping services in the highly fragmented U.S. and U.K. markets, operating under the only established, national brands in both markets (Brundage-Bone and Camfaud, respectively). Concrete pumping is a "mission-critical" method of concrete placement that requires highly-skilled operators to position a truck-mounted fully-articulating boom for precise delivery of ready-mix concrete from mixer trucks to placing crews on a job site. CPH's large fleet of specialized pumping equipment and highly-trained operators position CPH to deliver concrete placement solutions that facilitate substantial labor cost savings to customers, shorten concrete placement times, enhance worksite safety and improve construction quality. CPH operates a fee-based revenue model with no bonding requirements.

P1.4.text: CPH is also the leading provider of concrete waste management services in the U.S. market, operating under the only established, national brand, Eco-Pan. Highly complementary to its core concrete pumping service, Eco-Pan provides a full-service, cost-effective, regulatory-compliant solution to manage environmental issues caused by concrete washout.

P1.5.text: As of, the Company provided concrete pumping services in the U.S. from a footprint of multiple branch locations across approximately 20 states, concrete pumping services in the U.K. from multiple branch locations, and route-based concrete waste management services from multiple operating locations in the U.S. and 1 shared location in the U.K.

P1.6.text: For more information, please visit www.concretepumpingholdings.com or the Company’s brand websites at www.brundagebone.com, www.camfaud.co.uk, or www.eco-pan.com.

P1.8.text: Brundage-Bone is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United States.

P1.10.text: Capital Pumping is a leading provider of concrete pumping services in Texas.

P1.12.text: Camfaud is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service provider in the United Kingdom.

P1.14.text: Eco-Pan is the leading provider of environmental waste management services to the concrete industry in the United States. We specialize in concrete cleanup and disposal services across the country.

P1.15.text: Our team has extensive expertise in providing top-notch concrete pumping service in the U.S. under the Brundage-Bone brand, concrete pumping service in the U.K. under the Camfaud brand, and concrete waste management services in the U.S. under the Eco-Pan brand.

P2.1.text: U.K. Concrete Pumping - Camfaud :: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc.

P2.2.text: Camfaud is the largest concrete pumping company in the U.K. As of, the Company provides concrete pumping services from multiple locations throughout the U.K., offering the largest, most diverse fleet in the country.

P3.1.text: U.S. Concrete Pumping - Brundage-Bone :: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc.

P3.2.text: Brundage-Bone is the largest concrete pumping and material placement service in the United States. with just one location in Denver, Colorado, Brundage-Bone provides concrete pumping services in the U.S. with a fleet of 482 equipment units from a highly diversified footprint of multiple locations across 22 states (as of). Since our origin we have more experience pumping concrete than anyone. Brundage-Bone supplies the largest and most diverse fleet of concrete pumping vehicles and equipment with the most multi-regional locations across the nation. Due to our vast knowledge of concrete pumping, we continue to lead the industry in technology, customer service, fleet and location size, training, and safety.

P1.1.text: Construction Partners Inc. | Building Connected Communities

P1.2.text: We're a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company operating across eight Sunbelt states. Our hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, and liquid asphalt terminals support our focus on constructing, repairing, and maintaining surface infrastructure.

P1.3.text: We are a family of companies dedicated to building better lives and the infrastructure that keeps our communities connected.

P1.4.text: A Leading Asphalt-Centered Infrastructure Company in the Sunbelt Region

P1.5.text: We are a vertically integrated civil infrastructure company operating in local markets throughout eight Sunbelt states. Our hot-mix asphalt plants, aggregate facilities, and liquid asphalt terminals support our focus on constructing, repairing, and maintaining surface infrastructure.

P1.6.text: Asphalt Solutions for the Road Ahead

P1.7.text: Construction Partners operates a network of asphalt plants, construction teams, liquid asphalt terminals, and aggregate facilities that work together to support its projects and customers. This integrated approach improves efficiency, ensures reliability, and creates long-term value in the markets it serves.

P1.8.text: Dedicated teams across our family of companies deliver quality, safety, and service that define who we are.

P1.9.text: Each company is locally led and community-focused, building the roads and connections that bring people together.

P1.10.text: Our family of companies serves communities across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Oklahoma, and Texas. Construction Partners supports its companies and local teams in successfully building and operating in the markets they serve.

P1.12.text: Construction Partners, Inc. Completes Texas Acquisition

P1.13.text: Construction Partners, Inc. Completes Florida Acquisition

P1.14.text: Construction Partners, Inc. Completes Oklahoma Acquisition

P1.15.text: We believe growth is strongest when it’s built on shared values. For business owners, joining our family of companies means preserving your legacy, supporting your employees, and gaining the resources of a leader in civil infrastructure.

P1.16.text: Honor your company’s legacy and reputation while gaining the support of a trusted partner.

P1.17.text: Access shared resources and expertise to help your business operate efficiently and competitively.

P1.18.text: Join a network of respected companies that share your commitment to quality, safety, and community.

P1.19.text: Offer every one of your employees an opportunity to become an owner of Construction Partners.

P2.2.text: Construction Partners is an asphalt infrastructure company serving the Sunbelt with locally led teams committed to quality, safety, and growth.

P2.3.text: Construction Partners was built on a clear and focused vision: to acquire and partner with locally led infrastructure companies that share a commitment to quality, safety, and family values. Together, this network of companies builds the transportation systems that connect people, strengthen economies, and support long-term growth across the regions we serve.

P2.4.text: We source and grade aggregates close to projects to cut haul time and cost.

P2.5.text: Liquid asphalt is stored and blended to secure supply and meet specifications.

P2.6.text: Computer-controlled plants produce hot-mix and recycle reclaimed asphalt.

P2.7.text: Local crews pave, mill, and maintain roads, runways, and sites—safely and reliably.

P2.8.text: Construction Partners is an asphalt-centered infrastructure company that builds, repairs, and maintains the surfaces that keep communities moving, including highways, local roads, interstate corridors, airport runways, bridges, and commercial sites. Across the fast-growing Sunbelt region, our locally led teams deliver dependable projects that improve connectivity, enhance safety, and support regional growth.

P2.10.text: Our family of companies serves communities across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Oklahoma, and Texas. We combine the resources of a public company with the responsiveness of teams who live and work in the markets they serve.

P2.11.text: A proven operating model built for execution and long-term value, strengthened through strong partnerships and a focus on building better markets.
